async def build_server() -> FastMCP:
    mcp = FastMCP("acme-assistant")
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10) as http:
        specs = (await http.get("https://config.example.com/mcp/tools.json")).json()
    for spec in specs:
        mcp.add_tool(HANDLERS[spec["handler"]], name=spec["name"],
                     description=spec["description"])
    return mcp

async def connect(session: ClientSession, pins: dict[str, str]):
    tools = (await session.list_tools()).tools
    for t in tools:
        if tool_hash(t) != pins.get(t.name):
            raise RuntimeError(f"tool {t.name} does not match pinned hash")
    state.tools = tools

@mcp.tool()
async def fetch_avatar(profile_image_url: str) -> bytes:

    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10, follow_redirects=True) as http:
        resp = await http.get(profile_image_url)

@server.call_tool()
async def call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict):
    if name != "get_invoice":
        raise ValueError(f"unknown tool {name}")
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT number, amount, due FROM invoices WHERE number = '%s'" % arguments["number"])
    row = cur.fetchone()
    return [types.TextContent(type="text", text=json.dumps(row, default=str))]

@mcp.tool()
def send_email(to: EmailStr, subject: str, body: str) -> str:
    """Send an email from the user's mailbox."""
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"], msg["To"], msg["Subject"] = SENDER, to, subject[:200]
    msg.set_content(body[:20000])
    with smtplib.SMTP_SSL(SMTP_HOST, 465) as s:
        s.login(SENDER, os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
        s.send_message(msg)
    return "sent"

@mcp.tool()
def grant_role(user_id: int, role: Literal["viewer", "editor", "admin"]) -> str:
    """Assign a role to a user in the organisation."""
    user = users.get(user_id)
    user.role = role
    users.save(user)
    audit.log("role_change", user_id=user_id, role=role)
    return f"{user.email} is now {role}"

@server.call_tool()
async def call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict):
    if name == "close_account":
        account = accounts.get(int(arguments["account_id"]))
        accounts.close(account, reason=str(arguments.get("reason", ""))[:200])
        return [types.TextContent(type="text", text=f"closed {account.id}")]
    raise ValueError(f"unknown tool {name}")

@mcp.tool()
async def merge_pull_request(repo: Literal["acme/web", "acme/api"], number: int) -> str:
    """Merge an open pull request into main."""
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN']}"}
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as http:
        r = await http.put(f"https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/pulls/{number}/merge", headers=headers)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.json()["sha"]

def run_sql(query: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Run any SQL statement against the sales database."""
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text(query))
        return [dict(r._mapping) for r in result] if result.returns_rows else []

async def connect_all(http: httpx.AsyncClient) -> list[ClientSession]:
    directory = (await http.get("https://directory.example.com/mcp/servers.json")).json()
    sessions = []
    for entry in directory["servers"]:
        transport = await stack.enter_async_context(streamablehttp_client(entry["url"]))
        session = await stack.enter_async_context(ClientSession(transport[0], transport[1]))
        await session.initialize()
        sessions.append(session)
    return sessions

async def connect_from_domain(domain: str) -> ClientSession:
    meta = (await http.get(f"https://{domain}/.well-known/mcp.json")).json()
    read, write, _ = await stack.enter_async_context(streamablehttp_client(meta["endpoint"]))
    session = await stack.enter_async_context(ClientSession(read, write))
    await session.initialize()
    return session

    command="uvx",

)

async def forecast(city: str) -> str:
    async with stdio_client(params) as (r, w), ClientSession(r, w) as s:
        await s.initialize()
        res = await s.call_tool("get_forecast", {"city": city[:80]})
        return res.content[0].text

@mcp.tool()
def ping_host(host: str) -> str:
    """Check whether an IP address answers ICMP ping."""
    addr = ipaddress.ip_address(host)
    proc = subprocess.run(["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "2", str(addr)],
                          capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    return proc.stdout

async def on_tools_changed(session: ClientSession) -> None:
    new_tools = (await session.list_tools()).tools
    changed = [t for t in new_tools if tool_hash(t) != state.pins.get(t.name)]
    if changed:
        state.tools = [t for t in new_tools if t not in changed]
        await ui.request_reapproval(changed)
    else:
        state.tools = new_tools

async def run_agent(prompt: str) -> str:
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['TOOLS_TOKEN']}"}
    async with streamablehttp_client("https://tools.example.com/mcp", headers=headers) as (r, w, _):
        async with ClientSession(r, w) as session:
            await session.initialize()
            tools = (await session.list_tools()).tools
            verify_pins(tools, PINNED_TOOL_HASHES)
            return await agent_loop(session, tools, prompt)
